choice.basis: The chart visually confirms that May's pumping volume is the lowest among all displayed months, with its bar top positioned well below the 10,000 m³ y-axis tick while all other bars are above it. The chart provides no explicit severity threshold, critical cutoff, or routing policy. The task requires a decision based on the dashboard alone, with no external policy tables or instructions supplied. Under the task's own terms, 'standard low-pumping follow-up' is the only non-escalated route available. The absence of a critical threshold or escalation policy means the only public option is to route May to standard follow-up, as escalation is not justified by any visible or supplied criterion.
choice.option_label: Route May to standard low-pumping follow-up
